provenance.description: Fictional reduced-order training sequence and thresholds. Not derived from Calm Lake or an operating procedure.

limits.protectionSettings: Defined in the separate synthetic rule set; fictional training values only.

fidelity.scope: Synthetic start/stop timing, reduced-order speed and excitation buildup, permissive checks, synchronism window and hydro-constrained MW ramp.
limitations: Not a validated turbine, governor, excitation or relay transient model.
No rotor inertia, three-phase transient, AVR limiter coordination or vendor sequence emulation.
Synchronism uses declared steady-state windows and a reduced-order phase approach, not a validated station sync-check relay.
